contentText.value:
Super low kilometre 2020 Corolla SX Hybrid Hatch – Legendary Reliability, Incredibly Cheap to Run!

Looking for the perfect hassle-free commuter? This 2020 Toyota Corolla SX Hybrid is the gold standard for bulletproof reliability and unmatched fuel economy. Sipping just 4.2L/100km, it slashes your fuel bills in half while delivering a smooth, tech-packed, and incredibly safe drive.

- Unbeatable Economy: Massive fuel savings with a combined 1.8L hybrid system using just 4.2L/100km
- Toyota Reliability: Legendary mechanical durability means total peace of mind and low maintenance costs
- SX Luxury: Loaded with premium tech, including a wireless phone charger, satellite navigation, and digital radio (DAB+)
- Smart Connectivity: Seamless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on a crisp 8.0-inch touchscreen
- 5-Star Safety: Top-tier ANCAP safety with Toyota Safety Sense (Active Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist, and Blind Spot Monitoring)
- Premium Comfort: Dual-zone climate control and a leather-wrapped steering wheel make daily driving a breeze
- Incredible condition: Full Service History and 2 full sets of keys

Full logbook service history & 2 keys included. Excellent condition inside and out, mechanically perfect, First to see will buy.

FORD FINANCE AVAILABLE. Receive a Free No-Obligation Quote Today!

JUST ARRIVED & PRICED TO SELL.

Highly sought-after combination with excellent options. Complete walk-around video available on request. Contact our friendly sales team today to arrange a walk-around video, finance quote, trade-in valuation or inspection.

Ideally situated in Melbourne’s beautiful Bayside just 10 minutes from the CBD on the  Highway, so take the wheel of your dream drive with absolute confidence – only from your Authorised Ford Retailer. 

With healthy, constantly evolving stock to choose from, we can also help find the perfect alternative if this vehicle is not quite right. We look forward to assisting you with your next purchase.

BUY WITH CONFIDENCE FROM A TRUSTED MULTI-FRANCHISE RETAILER:
-	Current Victorian Roadworthy Certificate
-	Full inspection by factory-trained technicians
-	Clear title and complete peace of mind
-	All-Inclusive Drive-Away pricing

FINANCE AVAILABLE DRIVE AWAY TODAY:
-	Flexible & Competitive finance options available
-	Fast, Free No Obligation approvals local and interstate buyers 
-	Ask us for a personalised finance quote today

WE MAKE IT EASY WITH ALL TRADE-INS WELCOME:
-	Online trade appraisals
-	Competitive market-based valuations
-	Fast and seamless changeover process

INTERSTATE BUYERS WELCOME:
-	Fast, safe and competitive transport options Australia-wide
-	Door-to-door delivery available 
-	Complete purchase process handled remotely 

ALL ON-ROAD COSTS INCLUDED FOR VICTORIAN BUYERS:
-	Roadworthy Certificate 
-	Registration 
-	Stamp Duty 
-	Transfer Fees 
-	No hidden costs, No surprises

WHY BUY FROM US? 
-	Australian Family-owned and operated nationwide automotive 
-	Proud supporters of local sports clubs and local employment
-	Full service, parts and accessory facilities
-	Over 600 reviews and a 4.5-star rating

WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY:
-	"They were fantastic to deal with! We were on a time schedule due to leave by a set date. They made the process super easy and took away all the stress. I cannot recommend them highly enough!! All the people involved in purchasing the new car were amazing. Nothing was too much trouble." Birgit
-	"Shopped around for a long time to find the right car. From the beginning a warm friendly welcome, a great professional service very hard to find these days. If anyone's looking for a new or used car. Go see the crew down here." Adam 
-	"I had a fantastic experience at  Ford, and the customer service was outstanding from start to finish." Dwayne

TRADING HOURS:
-	Monday to Friday: 8:30am - 5:30pm
-	Saturday: 9:00am - 5:00pm
-	Sunday: Closed

content.value: Independent Australian program that assesses the car's level of safety. Rated in stars out of 5.
The year in which this vehicle's ANCAP rating was applied.
The number of airbags the car is equipped with.
Type of electric motor used. Typically Permanent Magnet or Electro Magnet.
Type of battery used in an electric or hybrid vehicle - eg. Lithium ion, nickel metal hydride etc.
Electrical current type of Hybrid or EV, either AC or DC.
Electrical output of the electric motor, measured in volts.
Amperage available when discharged evenly over a 20 hour period (Ah)
This is the capacity of the high voltage battery that powers the motor. Measured in kilowatt hours (kWh). It is equivalent to the fuel tank on a regular vehicle.
This is the combined power outputs of both electric motors and the combustion engine in the vehicle.  Measured in kilowatts.
This is the power output of the vehicle's electric motor, measured in kilowatts.

This relates to the rotational force or 'strength' of a vehicle's engine, measured in Newton metres (Nm). Depending on the car, this could mean either more speed or more pulling/load carrying capability.
This is typically piston, rotary, electric or hybrid.
Measured in cubic centimetres.
Measured in Litres.
This is the method of how air and fuel are introduced to the engine, typically naturally aspirated, turbo (single or multiple), supercharging or twincharging (turbo with supercharger).
Layout of the cylinders within an engine, typically configured in a straight line (in-line) or a V.
Number of combustion chambers in an internal combustion engine.
The Camshaft is an internal component of a vehicle's engine that provides the correct timings for the valves to take in fuel and expel gasses from the engine.
A more efficient engine will typically have more valves per cylinder (typically 4).
Higher performance engines typically have higher compression ratios as there will be more force in each stroke from the piston in the cylinder, creating more power.
This is the engine model code as specified by the manufacturer.
This is the maximum power output of the vehicle's engine, measured in kilowatts (kW).
This is the maximum engine rpm where the peak power output is produced.

This relates to the rotational force or 'strength' of a vehicle's engine, measured in Newton metres (Nm). Depending on the car, this could mean either more speed or more pulling/load carrying capability.
This is the maximum engine rpm where the peak power output is produced.
This is calculated by dividing the vehicle's engine power by the vehicle's weight, expressed as kilowatt per tonne (kW/t).
E.g. Automatic (sports automatic, constantly variable transmission (CVT), dual clutch transmission (DCT) semi automatic), manual
The gear selector is most typically found mounted on the floor (stick), on the steering column (stalk or paddles) or on the dash or console areas.
Which wheels are driven by the engine
Fuel used by the engine, eg. Petrol, diesel, LPG etc
Capacity of a vehicle's fuel tank measured in litres.
The manufacturer's minimum recommended fuel octane level (eg. 91, 95, 98).
The maximum ethanol blend fuel that can be used in the vehicle (eg. E10, E85)
This is the type of fuel delivery to the engine, typically fuel-injected (single or multi port) or carburettor.
This is the method of how fuel is delivered to the engine, typically by electronics or mechanical input.
This is the official fuel consumption figure for a mix of city and highway driving conditions.
This is the official fuel consumption figure for highway driving conditions.
This is the official fuel consumption figure for city driving conditions.
The maximum distance that can be travelled on a full tank of fuel.
The minimum distance that can be travelled on a full tank of fuel.
This is the officially tested output of carbon dioxide emissions in grams per km from the engine based on a mix of city and highway driving conditions.
This is the officially tested output of carbon dioxide emissions in grams per km from the engine based on highway driving conditions.
This is the officially tested output of carbon dioxide emissions in grams per km from the engine based on city driving conditions.

Vehicles are rated in half star increments based upon the vehicle’s tailpipe carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions released per kilometre. Only vehicles with no tail pipe emissions achieve a 6-star rating. VESR is a star rating developed by NSW Government that has been applied to light passenger vehicles sold on the Australian market since 2004.
This is the level of Euro emission standards (up to Euro 6) that the vehicle complies with. The higher the number, the more environmentally friendly.
This is the type of steering on a vehicle e.g. rack and pinion, 4 wheel steering etc.
The material of a vehicle's wheel, either steel or alloy.
This is the size of a front wheel of a vehicle e.g. 16 inch, 16 x 7. This can show measurements for both wheel diameter and width.
This is the size of a rear wheel of a vehicle e.g. 16 inch, 16 x 7. This can show measurements for both wheel diameter and width.
This describes the width of the tyre in mm, the thickness of the wall of the tyre (profile), the construction type (usually radial), and the diameter of the tyre in inches.
This describes the width of the tyre in mm, the thickness of the wall of the tyre (profile), the construction type (usually radial), and the diameter of the tyre in inches.
Length of a vehicle at its longest point.
Width of a vehicle at its widest point (excluding mirrors).
Height of a vehicle at its highest point.
The distance between the centre of the front wheels and and the centre of the rear wheels.
The distance between a vehicle's front wheels taken from the centre of the tyres.
The distance between a vehicle's rear wheels taken from the centre of the tyres.
The total weight of a vehicle with standard equipment, no occupants and 10 litres of fuel.
Total weight of a vehicle with standard equipment, no occupants and a full tank of fuel.
This is the maximum weight of the vehicle including all occupants and any luggage.
The total capacity of a vehicle's luggage area measured in litres.
